name: tldraw_examples
installCmd: cd ../.. && COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 npm_config_engine_strict=false corepack pnpm install --filter './apps/examples...' --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline
testAllCmd: COV_OUT=cov_pertest NODE_OPTIONS='--no-strip-types' node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c e2e/__cov_playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --workers=2 test-routes.spec.ts --grep "comment-anchors|comment-regions|comment-notifications|custom-language-translations|cubic-bezier-shape|pen-tool|basic|custom-shape"
